market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Most Layer-2 tokens launch with FDVs well above $200M, often in the billions. Abstract, associated with the highly successful Pudgy Penguins and the consumer-focused L2 narrative, carries significant hype that makes a sub-$200M FDV unlikely. A modest 10% discount accounts for a possible failed launch or uniquely bearish market conditions at the time.
evidence_points: Comparable L2 tokens (Optimism, Arbitrum, zkSync, Blast) all launched with FDVs > $1B
Abstract has strong backing (Pudgy Penguins, Igloo Inc.) and a large pre-existing community
$200M FDV is a very low threshold relative to recent crypto project valuations
sources_consulted: General knowledge of L2 token launches
